c74object.name: evi.skfinputmix~
c74object.description:
evi.skfinputmix~ is a 'max define' for the evi_skfinputmix.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.skfinputmix~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A special kind of input mixing filter, where the multimode nature of the filter is provided by it's simultaneous inputs rather than on outputs. By default the inputs are mixed by the @mix attribute and therefore has the effect of output mixing a standard multimode Sallen Key. However if disabling the @mixenable attribute the inputs are 'always on', and can therefore be sequenced externally in interesting ways. This Sallen Key input mixer has excellent performance across a full range of cutoff frequencies. The filter is nonlinear and can take any sort of input.

inlet.description: Audio to this inlet produces the Lowpass output.
Audio to this inlet produces the Bandpass output.
Audio to this inlet produces the Highpass output.

attribute.name: coeffsmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the internal coefficients calculations. This takes care of smoothing the changes incurred by @cutoff and @res attributes. This should typically be on.

attribute.name: cutoff
attribute.description: The filter cutoff frequency in Hz. This filter performs predictably with a wide range of cutoff frequencies.

attribute.name: mix
attribute.description: Only available if @mixenable is on (the default). Interpolates between Lowpass..Bandpass..Highpass inlets. Interpolation is a gain matched cosine algorithm.

attribute.name: mixenable
attribute.description: If enabled (the default) the @mix attribute can interpolate between Lowpass..Bandpass..Highpass. Turn off for controlling the audio inputs via sequenced gates (for example).

attribute.name: mixsmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the @mix attribute if @mixenable is active. This should typically be on.

attribute.name: res
attribute.description: The filter resonance. Resonance in this filter performs predictably across the full range of @cutoff frequencies.
